context: Two teens plan a culture-museum weekend
purpose: Teach: 万博/ウィーン/秋葉原/金沢/モーツァルト/ドクター/芸術家/大賞

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今度の週末、大阪万博の関連展示行かない?
lines.en: Want to check out some of the Osaka Expo exhibits this weekend?
lines.style: Bright opening—genuine invitation, not performance. Slight lean-in, genuinely curious about his answer. Quick pace, natural enthusiasm without pushing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。秋葉原のレトロ展も気になるんだよな。
lines.en: Yeah, sounds good. I've been wanting to see that retro exhibition in Akihabara too.
lines.style: Thoughtful, half-engaged. Soft admission of his own interest. Not performing coolness—just being honest about what he wants. Slight warmth underneath the casual surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ウィーンの音楽家、モーツァルトの企画展、終わっちゃう前に見たい。
lines.en: There's this Mozart special—Vienna composers—and I really want to catch it before it closes.
lines.style: Urgency breaking through the casual tone. Slightly faster, more animated on the second half. Real stake in this, not just floating the idea. Slight stress on the time limit.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 金沢にも、芸術家コレクションの巡回展、来てるって。
lines.en: There's also a traveling collection at Kanazawa, I heard. Artists' collection—pretty big deal.
lines.style: Soft knowledge-sharing, not showing off. Conversational, almost thinking out loud. Offering it as a real option, not trying to impress. Even pace, grounded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ドクター中田さんの講演、それも大賞獲るレベルらしいよ。
lines.en: And there's Dr. Nakata's lecture—supposedly award-winning level.
lines.style: Still animated, but quieter than before. Building the case genuinely. Slight emphasis on the stakes of it. Not overselling, just laying out what's real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 予定詰めて、二日でこなそ。
lines.en: We could pack it all in and do it over two days.
lines.style: Decisive, almost to herself first then to him. Quick, efficient. A plan forming in real time. Slight excitement at the logistics clicking into place. Firm but not forceful.
